contexts.text: That (the Human of the Lord) would be a stumbling block and a scandal, is predicted in the Word. AC 3704:7.
To the evil, dignities and wealth are stumbling blocks.
All things that cause stumbling (). Explained.
I lay stumbling blocks before this people (). These stumbling blocks upon which the fathers and sons stumble = the perversions of good and truth; fathers = goods; and sons, truths.
That such are not infested by evils and falsities, is signified by they have no stumbling block ().

That the evil are to be separated from the good, is signified by, the Angels shall gather together all things that cause stumbling (). ( = that Divine truth will remove those things which hinder the separation. AE 911:6.)
To be affected by falsities and live according to them, is signified by to put the stumbling block of iniquity before his faces ().
